_comment: Scoring grid read by scripts/score_prospects.py. The model never scores a prospect: it writes facts into prospect.json, scripts/verify_dossiers.py checks them, this grid turns the verified ones into a score and a tier. Copy to <project>/cold-outreach-builder/criteria.json and edit for your ICP. Points are a ranking device, not a prediction of replies.

freshness._comment: A verified fact older than fact_max_age_days is kept in the dossier but never scores and never becomes a hook. A strong signal must be younger than strong_max_age_days to put a prospect in tier A.

fact_types._comment: points per verified fact type (the best fact of each type counts once), strong = can carry a tier A email on its own.

recency._comment: Bonus from the age in days of the freshest verified fact: the first step whose max_days holds wins.

role._comment: First tier whose pattern is found in the role (case-insensitive) wins. An empty pattern matches every role.

geography._comment: Compared with prospect.json geography (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, lowercase).

icp_keywords._comment: Counted in the claims and excerpts of verified facts, plus role and company.

exclude._comment: Any disqualifier in prospect.json, or a relationship other than none, sends the prospect to tier C with the reason: a known contact gets a personal note from the founder, not a cold sequence.
